question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Vanish into thin air
solution:
The correct answer is: **disappear**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The idiom '**Vanish into thin air**' is an expression used to disappear completely in a way that is mysterious.

 
 
• Example- *The wizard waved his wand and** vanished into thin air.__***
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom '**Vanish into thin air****​**' is '**disappear**'.

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
